The whole reply is in Chinese.

notes: Strong exam-prep opening in one message. It uses the exam format from the notes (选择 30% / 简答 40% / 计算 30%), gives a per-day plan that ends the day before the exam, offers a sensible default ('直接回"开始"…按"看过但不牢"'), and correctly says chat-only means no reminders and no memory across chats, so a progress JSON will be handed over. Factual check: the 6-day count (10-31 to 11-05) is correct. The cwnd = ssthresh + 3 MSS variant is accurate; it is the classic Reno/RFC 5681 window inflation during fast recovery. Minor issues: the fast-recovery aside reveals a testable rule before any testing. Labelling 四次挥手与 TIME_WAIT as purely factual is defensible but debatable, since why the active closer waits 2MSL is conceptual. The claim '学完第二天的复习效果最好' is stated more firmly than the evidence supports. The reply is fairly long for an opener (~600 characters of schedule), but nothing in it is wrong.
